d:
Tejashwi Yadav on JDU rashtriy janta dal (rajad) ke rashtriy karyakari adhyaksh aur bihar vidhanasbha men vipaksh ke neta tejasvi yadav ne guruvar ko kendr sarkar aur bhajpa par hamla bolte hue janta dal yunaited (jadyu) men jari kathit gutbaji ko lekar nishana sadha. unhonne dava kiya ki jadyu ab janta dal yunaited nahin rah gaee hai, balki janta dal 'divaided' ho gaee hai.
